English: Signal Post
A simple wooden post raised on the steppe, where messengers can leave marks or signals for passing riders. Useful for basic communication and early warnings between clans.
Runners Shelter
A crude, hide-covered lean-to providing rest and cover for clan runners and messengers. Shelter from the elements encourages more frequent communication.
Relay Yurt
A modest yurt established along messenger routes, equipped for swift horse changes and shelter. It helps maintain a steady flow of information across the steppes.
Message Stand
A wooden stand and notice board where written and carved messages are left for passing warriors and travelers. Marks a maturing communications network.
Flagstaff Station
A permanent pole and signal fire post, staffed to send smoke and flag signals over great distances. Enables rapid alerting of all nearby clans.
Mounted Courier Post
A small complex of stables and rest yurts, where trained couriers switch horses for maximum speed. Greatly improves horde coordination and response time.
Falcon Loft
A grand structure for housing trained messenger falcons, allowing for the fastest dispatches to distant kin. The pride of any nomad khan.
Swift Relay Camp
A fortified and well-supplied encampment for elite messengers and their horses, ensuring the near-instant transmission of orders and news across the realm.
Fleet Rider Pavilion
A grand yurt-pavilion reserved for the fastest riders and their best steeds, boasting advanced logistics, stores, and scribes. Maximizes communication, unity, and response in a sprawling khanate.
Imperial Courier Quarters
A sprawling, luxurious headquarters for the empires supreme couriers. Boasts the finest stables, falconries, and administrative halls. Ensures instant response and ironclad unity across the steppe.
